title: Topic 1.1: My purpose Talents and abilities

pages.lesson:
LESSON: MY PURPOSE TALENTS AND ABILITIES

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Creation
Topic 1.1: My purpose Talents and abilities

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about My purpose Talents and abilities. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: what they have learnt, 1. Why is it important to know your talents, gifts and abilities?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify God’s purpose for his or her life to live meaningfully
2. apply lessons learnt from the parable in their day-to-day life

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify God’s purpose for his or her life to live meaningfully
   In simple words: practise until you can identify God’s purpose for his or her life to live meaningfully. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. apply lessons learnt from the parable in their day-to-day life
   In simple words: practise until you can apply lessons learnt from the parable in their day-to-day life. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about My purpose Talents and abilities using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about My purpose Talents and abilities in the examples.
2. Explain My purpose Talents and abilities to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand My purpose Talents and abilities.
4. Show that you can: identify God’s purpose for his or her life to live meaningfully

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about My purpose Talents and abilities using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is My purpose Talents and abilities important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. In groups, discuss how the activities they have listed aid in nurturing their talents, gifts and abilities,
2. Discuss God’s purpose for his or her life; Jeremiah 29:11,
3. In pairs, list what they want to become in future,
4. Discuss why it is important to live a purposeful life,
5. In turns, read Matthew 25:14-30 on the parable of the talents and narrate how different talents were used,

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. what they have learnt, 1. Why is it important to know your talents, gifts and abilities?
2. How do you nurture your talents, gifts and abilities?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify God’s purpose for his or her life to live meaningfully
2. apply lessons learnt from the parable in their day-to-day life

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
